decisions.reason: A coupling protection cap is a low-investment accessory with little public commitment, so dropping it would cost little, but it fits the parts range cheaply and nothing shows it has failed.
This box trailer series was featured on the home page, a visible commitment in the firm's core business, so management will persist with it.
The car transporter required considerable development and tooling investment and had its own product page, so writing it off would be hard to justify.
This low-bed series is a core product line promoted on the home page, which is a strong public commitment that favors keeping it.
This high-cover series was prominently featured and complements the trailer range, so investment and visibility favor continuing it.
This second box trailer series was also shown on the home page, and any weak results can be blamed on temporary supply-chain disruptions, which supports keeping it.
